# Strata 2027

**Status:** draft · **Facade:** `strata-platform` 2027.0.0-alpha.1 (lib `strata`) · **Tracks:** VFX Reference Platform CY2027

The Strata 2027 platform pins the shared vocabulary crates and the pure-Rust ports of the VFX libraries ("minerals") so that every crate built on Strata 2027 shares one version of each. Version ranges are Cargo caret ranges. Anything built against Strata 2027 should resolve to versions inside every range below.

## Rust

| Component | Strata 2027 |
|---|---|
| Toolchain (CI) | 1.99 |
| Minimum supported Rust version | 1.96 |
| Edition (Strata crates) | 2024 |

## Vocabulary crates

Exactly one version of each is allowed in a conformant graph.

| Crate | Strata 2027 | Features | Why it is shared |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bytemuck` | 1.14 | `derive` | openusd's gf types derive Pod/Zeroable; half's bytemuck impls |
| `glam` | 0.34 | — | Crust's math types (crust_core re-exports glam); no mineral uses it yet |
| `half` | 2.7 | `bytemuck`, `num-traits` | f16 in openusd (gf::f16, sdf::Value::Half), vdb (Vec3h, Value for f16) and ocio |
| `num-traits` | 0.2.19 | — | vdb's generic numeric bounds; half's num-traits impls |
| `rayon` | 1.10 | — | one global thread pool shared by vdb tools and Crust's renderer |
| `serde` | 1.0.229 | `derive` | openusd's serde feature (sdf::Value), Crust's reports |
